rationale: The distribution-drip thesis remains fully intact — five more flat-to-red 1-minute closes since entry with the latest printing the heaviest volume (14,002) and closing at its low, price now ~4.6% below VWAP and under the 9-EMA with zero bounce attempts, and no new headlines. The $12.06 session-low target is only ~0.7% away while the $12.51 invalidation still bounds worst-case giveback (≈$233 from here, recovered profit included) well inside the $465 budget. A flip long has no mechanical support (no VWAP reclaim, no absorption), and closing now forfeits the final leg of a trade that has shown essentially no adverse excursion, so holding to the target is the highest-EV action.
